d: Grand Theft Auto 6 has sparked a global frenzy, but its impact goes far beyond video game sales. With development costs reportedly crossing $1 billion and pre-sales estimated at more than $1.5 billion, GTA 6 is shaping up to be one of the biggest entertainment launches ever. From console makers and online streamers to fast-food chains, retailers and quick-commerce platforms, businesses are looking to cash in on the hype. We break down the numbers behind GTA 6 and explore how one video game could give the entire gaming industry a massive boost.
